description: This file defines a Roslyn code fix provider named IdClashAttributeCodeFix within the Orleans.Analyzers namespace. It provides automated fixes for diagnostics related to ID clashes, specifically incrementing attribute ID values to resolve conflicts.

classes.name: IdClashAttributeCodeFix
classes.description: A CodeFixProvider that offers a fix for ID clashes detected by IdClashAttributeAnalyzer. It increments the ID value in the attribute to resolve conflicts.

methods.name: RegisterCodeFixesAsync
methods.description: Registers a code fix that increments the conflicting ID value within the attribute to a new, higher value.

methods.name: GetFixAllProvider
methods.description: Provides a fixer that can apply fixes to all occurrence diagnostics in a batch.
